SELECT 'store' AS kind, CAST(store_key AS VARCHAR) AS k, CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR) AS id, store_name AS name, city AS a, region AS b, CAST(valid_from AS VARCHAR) AS c, CAST(valid_to AS VARCHAR) AS d
FROM dim_store WHERE city ILIKE '%lahti%' OR store_name ILIKE '%lahti%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'product', category, subcategory, CAST(count(DISTINCT sku) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS VARCHAR), NULL, NULL
FROM dim_product WHERE category ILIKE '%paint%' OR subcategory ILIKE '%paint%' OR subcategory ILIKE '%interior%'
GROUP BY category, subcategory

WITH lines AS (
  SELECT f.*, p.subcategory AS sub_was, p.category AS cat_was, cp.subcategory AS sub_now, cp.category AS cat_now, p.product_name
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
)
SELECT sub_now, sub_was, cat_now, cat_was,
  count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_keys, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_ids,
  sum(quantity) AS units, sum(CASE WHEN quantity < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_rows, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS staff_units,
  min(sale_date) AS d0, max(sale_date) AS d1, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM lines
WHERE sub_now ILIKE '%paint%' OR sub_was ILIKE '%paint%' OR sub_now ILIKE '%interior%' OR sub_was ILIKE '%interior%'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH tot AS (
  SELECT sum(f.quantity) AS fact_units, count(*) AS fact_rows, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS fact_keys
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
), ctl AS (
  SELECT sum(units_sold) AS rpt_units, sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_gross, count(*) AS rpt_days
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id = 108 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
), tot_net AS (
  SELECT sum(f.net_amount) AS fact_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
), ret_date AS (
  SELECT sum(r.quantity_returned) AS ret_units_by_return_date, count(*) AS ret_rows
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
), ret_cohort AS (
  SELECT sum(r.quantity_returned) AS ret_units_of_period_sales, count(*) AS ret_rows_c
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
)
SELECT * FROM tot, ctl, tot_net, ret_date, ret_cohort
